name: westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_on_ok
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConfigDialog::OnOK saves the two profile records through the WOL API provider, persists the WOL password-save option, and accepts the dialog.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The WOL API object and MFC CDialog::OnOK are verified as provider boundaries by smoke-test patches rather than by live UI or network provider execution.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x441f40 validates a thiscall void method that branches on m_wolPasswordFlag, calls the WOL API provider slot at offset 0x94 for profile ids 1 and 2, uses the empty string and mode 0 when password saving is disabled, uses active connect strings and mode == 0 as the provider flag when password saving is enabled, stores the option through zOpt::SetWolPasswordFlag, and calls CDialog::OnOK.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_on_ok_smoke patches the WOL API and MFC providers and verifies both disabled and enabled password-save branches, saved profile ids, player/connect string arguments, mode flags, persisted zOpt password flag value, and base CDialog::OnOK dispatch.
